_comment: This file intentionally contains NO real secrets. Every value below is either a safe production default or a placeholder that MUST be overridden by an environment variable at deploy time (see docker-compose.yml / .env.production.example). ASP.NET Core's configuration system reads environment variables named Section__Key (double underscore) automatically, taking precedence over this file.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Override with the ConnectionStrings__Postgres environment variable.

Cors._comment: Override with the Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 (and __1, __2, ...) environment variables — set to the real deployed frontend origin(s), e.g. https://crm.daftech.et.

Jwt._comment: SigningKey MUST be overridden with the Jwt__SigningKey environment variable (generate with: openssl rand -base64 48). The app refuses to start without one at least 32 bytes long.

Smtp._comment: Override Host/Username/Password with Smtp__Host / Smtp__Username / Smtp__Password environment variables.

AiReporting._comment: Override ApiKey with the AiReporting__ApiKey environment variable if AI narrative reports are enabled.
